notes.title: Stella patch 4
notes.content: [h2]bug fixes and quality of life improvements[/h2][list][*][p]cards and elements you discover are now also saved to your collection when you quit to main menu instead of only at the end of a lightyear[/p][/*][*][p]fixed chaos stella not being unlocked in certain cases[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Stella patch 3
notes.content: [h2]new content[/h2][list][*][p]there are now more run details displayed at the end of a run, including how long the run was, total collected points, total money gained/lost, and the highest card and element that generated the highest points.[/p][/*][*][p]three new cards, boson star, orcus, and nix. discover them in a run to find out what they do.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]bug fixes and quality of life improvements[/h2][list][*][p]fixed element limit increase minimum price and deck expansion tracking not being saved correctly[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some cards' border effect not using correct color when a value changes to a different value type, such as evoluzio changing a card's mult to final mult[/p][/*][*][p]io now updates its final mult if the final mult of the card after it changes after it is played, such as when playing jupiter[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Stella patch 2
notes.content: [h2]new content[/h2][list][*][p]new border effect on cards when you hover over them[/p][/*][*][p]two new elements, giornatas and nottes. discover them in a run to find out what they do.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]card and element changes[/h2][p]cosmic cards:[/p][list][*][p]galaxy: now updates its percent and final add every time the points change until it is counted[/p][/*][*][p]starburst: [/p][list][*][p]now shows how many points it will give before it's played[/p][/*][*][p]permanently increases by 3% -> 2%~4%[/p][/*][*][p]now has a max of 60%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]blazar: [/p][list][*][p]increase by -.5~1 after every lightyear -> -1~1[/p][/*][*][p]increase by -.5~2 every time an anomaly card appears -> -1~2[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]elements[/p][list][*][p]fermoso: price $3 -> $1[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]bug fixes and quality of life improvements[/h2][list][*][p]fixed mortus being able to be disabled and sold[/p][/*][*][p]fixed being able to hover over and click on cards through the deck view[/p][/*][*][p]fixed cards in the deck view sometimes being vertically off center when hovering on and off a card very quickly[/p][/*][*][p]added some clarification to some elements to say they only work on cards (like ventus and cristallus)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed not being able to play the last card if you have more than one mentes and even one mentes gets disabled[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Stella patch 1
notes.content: [h2]balance changes[/h2][p]star cards:[/p][list][*][p]hybrid: final add -20 -> -25. final mult 3.6 -> 2.5[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]saving on lightyear 1 now works[/p][/*][*][p]window mode, resolution, and disable tutorial buttons now work in the options menu during a run[/p][/*][*][p]"saved at start of lightyear x" text now displays the correct lightyear while in the shop[/p][/*][/list]
